entities.name: 5G Subscription Permanent Identifier
entities.description: A globally unique permanent identity allocated to each subscriber for 5GS-based services. Valid types include IMSI, network specific identifier, GCI, and GLI. When containing network specific identifier, GCI or GLI, it takes the form of a Network Access Identifier (NAI).

entities.name: Subscription Concealed Identifier
entities.description: A privacy preserving identifier containing the concealed SUPI. When SUPI contains network specific identifier, GCI or GLI, SUCI takes the form of a NAI.

entities.name: Permanent Equipment Identifier
entities.description: Permanent equipment identifier used by UE for accessing 5GS-based services. Supported formats include IMEI, IMEISV, MAC address with usage restriction indication, and EUI-64.

entities.name: Null Scheme
entities.description: A scheme where SUCI contains the unconcealed SUPI. Used when home network hasn't provisioned public key, when configured to use null-scheme, or during emergency services registration.

entities.name: Anonymous SUCI
entities.description: SUCI used when UE is configured with indication to use anonymous SUCI associated with list of subscriber data or default UE credentials, and not performing emergency services.

entities.name: REGISTRATION REQUEST
entities.description: NAS message that can contain SUCI when UE attempts initial registration without valid 5G-GUTI, or PEI for emergency registration when neither SUPI nor valid 5G-GUTI is available.

entities.name: IDENTITY RESPONSE
entities.description: NAS message that contains SUCI when requested by network during identification procedure, or PEI when network requests PEI.

entities.name: DEREGISTRATION REQUEST
entities.description: NAS message that contains SUCI when UE initiates de-registration procedure without valid 5G-GUTI.

entities.name: SECURITY MODE COMPLETE
entities.description: NAS message that contains PEI when network requests IMEISV during security mode control procedure.

entities.name: Emergency Registration
entities.description: Registration procedure for emergency services where UE may use null-scheme for SUCI or include PEI when neither SUPI nor valid 5G-GUTI is available.

entities.name: Identification Procedure
entities.description: Procedure where network can request SUCI or PEI from UE using IDENTITY REQUEST message.

entities.name: Security Mode Control Procedure
entities.description: Procedure where network can request IMEISV from UE, and UE responds with PEI in SECURITY MODE COMPLETE message.

relations.description: SUCI contains the concealed SUPI as a privacy preserving identifier.
REGISTRATION REQUEST message contains SUCI when UE attempts initial registration without valid 5G-GUTI.
IDENTITY RESPONSE message contains SUCI when requested by network during identification procedure.
DEREGISTRATION REQUEST message contains SUCI when UE initiates de-registration without valid 5G-GUTI.
REGISTRATION REQUEST message contains PEI for emergency registration when neither SUPI nor valid 5G-GUTI is available.
IDENTITY RESPONSE message contains PEI when network requests PEI during identification procedure.
SECURITY MODE COMPLETE message contains PEI when network requests IMEISV during security mode control procedure.
SUCI generation uses null-scheme under specific conditions including lack of public key, configuration, or emergency services.
SUCI generation uses anonymous SUCI when configured and not performing emergency services.
Emergency registration procedure may require use of null-scheme for SUCI generation.
Identification procedure includes step where network can request SUCI from UE.
Identification procedure includes step where network can request PEI from UE.
Security mode control procedure includes step where network can request IMEISV and UE responds with PEI.
